title: SummerCup 2
wikitext:
[[Image:SummerCup2-logo.jpg|right|SummerCup 2 Logo]] == Introduction == A Finnish QuakeWorld [[4on4]] tournament which took place in the fall of [[2001]]. This league also featured unique matches during the group stage as 4 players from all of the 5 clans played [[death32c]] at the same time. These matches were part of the actual league and not for showmatch purposes. The winner clan was awarded three points, the second clan was awarded two, and the third clan one.
